blocks.text: Tailscale is installed only when selected. An installed client or running daemon can still await enrollment; pending enrollment is an expected state until you approve joining the intended account/network.

Service status is not proof of authentication or peer reachability. Use the existing enrollment workflow and verify the intended account yourself. Help never enrolls, contacts a control server or collects Tailscale addresses.

Keep the repository's configured interface, DNS, route and netfilter policy. Do not run an arbitrary tailscale up command copied from another host: flags may change routing, DNS, SSH exposure or exit-node use.
